class.name: JRPGActorCommand
class.brief_description: The base of the event commands that act on an actor or on the entire party.
class.description: Picks the actors an actor command acts on: actor [member actor_id], or the entire party ([constant ENTIRE_PARTY]); or, with [member actor_is_variable], the actor whose ID variable [member actor_variable_id] holds. An actor the database lacks is skipped with one warning per command; an actor the game has not used yet is set up as it would be on joining. Authority: server.

members.member: The actor's ID is read from variable [member actor_variable_id].
The variable holding the actor's ID.

constants.constant: The [member actor_id] that stands for every party member.
